# Core language semantics (jslex.c literal forms, jsparse.c/jscompile.c statements,
# jsrun.c operators + jsvalue.c coercions).
#
# HARNESS FORMAT: one snippet per line; `\n` -> newline, `\t` -> tab.
# Because `\n` is rewritten, a JS "\n" escape cannot appear here; use
# String.fromCharCode(10) when a newline character is needed.

# --- statements: if/else, while, do-while, for ---
(function(){var a=1; if (a) return 'yes'; else return 'no'})()
(function(){if (0) return 'yes'; else if (1) return 'elseif'; else return 'no'})()
(function(){var n=0; while (n<5) n++; return n})()

(function(){var n=0; do { n++ } while (0); return n})()
(function(){var s=0; for (var i=0;i<5;i++) s+=i; return s})()
(function(){var s=0; for (var i=0;;i++) { if (i>3) break; s+=i } return s})()
(function(){var i=0; for (;;) { i++; if (i>2) break } return i})()
(function(){var s=''; for (var i=0;i<5;i++) { if (i%2) continue; s+=i } return s})()

# --- for-in ---
(function(){var r=[]; for (var k in {a:1,b:2,c:3}) r.push(k); return r.join(',')})()
(function(){var r=[]; for (var k in [10,20,30]) r.push(k); return r.join(',')})()
(function(){var r=[]; for (var k in 'abc') r.push(k); return r.join(',')})()
(function(){var r=0; for (var k in null) r++; return r})()
(function(){var r=0; for (var k in undefined) r++; return r})()
(function(){var o={}; var r=[]; for (var k in o) r.push(k); return r.length})()
(function(){function P(){}; P.prototype.p=1; var o=new P(); o.own=2; var r=[]; for (var k in o) r.push(k); return r.sort().join(',')})()
(function(){var o={a:1,b:2}; var r=[]; for (var k in o) { if (k=='a') continue; r.push(k) } return r.join(',')})()
(function(){var a=[1,2,3]; var s=''; for (a[3] in {x:0}) s+=a[3]; return s})()

# --- switch: fallthrough, default in the middle, no match ---
(function(){switch (2) { case 1: return 'one'; case 2: return 'two'; default: return 'def' }})()
(function(){var s=''; switch (1) { case 1: s+='a'; case 2: s+='b'; case 3: s+='c'; break; case 4: s+='d' } return s})()
(function(){var s=''; switch (9) { case 1: s+='a'; break; default: s+='D'; case 2: s+='b'; break; case 3: s+='c' } return s})()
(function(){var s=''; switch (3) { case 1: s+='a'; break; default: s+='D'; case 3: s+='c'; break } return s})()
(function(){switch ('x') { case 1: return 'n'; default: return 'd' }})()
(function(){switch (0) { case '0': return 'strict-eq-fails'; default: return 'default' }})()
(function(){var s=''; switch (1) {} return 'empty'})()

# --- break / continue with and without labels ---
(function(){var s=''; outer: for (var i=0;i<3;i++) { for (var j=0;j<3;j++) { if (j==1) continue outer; s+=''+i+j } } return s})()
(function(){var s=''; outer: for (var i=0;i<3;i++) { for (var j=0;j<3;j++) { if (i==1) break outer; s+=''+i+j } } return s})()
(function(){var s=''; blk: { s+='a'; break blk; s+='b' } return s+'c'})()
(function(){var n=0; lab: while (n<10) { n++; if (n<5) continue lab; break lab } return n})()
(function(){var s=''; for (var i=0;i<3;i++) { switch(i) { case 1: continue } s+=i } return s})()

# --- try / catch / finally in all combinations, throw ---
(function(){try { return 'body' } catch(e) { return 'catch' }})()
(function(){try { throw 1 } catch(e) { return 'caught '+e }})()
(function(){try { return 'body' } finally { }})()
(function(){var s=''; try { s+='t' } finally { s+='f' } return s})()
(function(){var s=''; try { throw 'x' } catch(e) { s+='c'+e } finally { s+='f' } return s})()
(function(){try { return 'try' } finally { return 'finally' }})()
(function(){var s=''; try { try { throw 'in' } finally { s+='f1' } } catch(e) { s+='c'+e } return s})()
(function(){try { throw new Error('boom') } catch(e) { return e.name+': '+e.message }})()
(function(){try { throw new TypeError('t') } catch(e) { return [e instanceof TypeError, e instanceof Error].join(',') }})()
(function(){try { null.x } catch(e) { return e.name }})()
(function(){try { nosuchfn() } catch(e) { return e.name }})()
(function(){try { throw {code:7} } catch(e) { return e.code }})()
(function(){var e2; try { throw 'a' } catch(e) { e2=e } return e2})()
(function(){var s=''; for (var i=0;i<3;i++) { try { if (i==1) continue; s+=i } finally { s+='f' } } return s})()
(function(){function f(){ try { throw 'x' } catch(e) { return 1 } finally { } } return f()})()
(function(){try { try { throw 'a' } catch(e) { throw 'b' } } catch(e) { return e }})()
(function(){var x=1; try { throw 2 } catch(x) { } return x})()
(function(){try { throw 2 } catch(x) { return typeof x }})()
